info.title: Send, thanks API
info.description: Send, thanks email sending, domains, API keys, contacts, audiences, broadcasts, automations, inbound receiving, webhooks, suppressions and usage. Send, thanks uses its configured SMTP relay.

schema.description: Comma-separated list. Supports received, sent, failed, suppressed, delivered, delivery_delayed, bounced, bounced_transient, bounced_permanent, bounced_undetermined, complained, opened, unique_opened, clicked, unique_clicked, unsubscribed, delivery_rate, open_rate, click_rate, bounce_rate, complaint_rate and unsubscribe_rate. Recipient outcome counts require signed delivery notifications.
